apps.name: Melodix
apps.description:
Melodix — Music, Your Way.

Melodix is a modern, free music streaming experience designed for people who simply love music. Discover new tracks, revisit your favourites, create playlists, and enjoy your music in a clean and beautifully crafted interface.

🎧 Discover Your Sound

Explore a growing collection of songs, artists, albums, and genres. Whether you're looking for something new or returning to an old favourite, Melodix makes discovering music effortless.

❤️ Your Music, Your Collection

Save the songs you love and build your personal music library. Create playlists around your mood, taste, or moment and keep everything you enjoy in one place.

🔎 Find It Fast

Search for songs, artists, albums, and more with a simple and intuitive search experience.

🎵 A Beautiful Listening Experience

Melodix focuses on what matters most — your music. Enjoy a clean interface, smooth navigation, and a distraction-free player designed to make listening feel effortless.

✨ Made for Music Lovers

No complicated setup. No unnecessary clutter. Just open Melodix, find something you love, and press play.

Melodix — Discover. Listen. Repeat.

apps.name: Friindzy
apps.tagline: Your AI friend for coding, ideas, answers, and everyday tasks.
apps.description:
Meet Friindzy — your AI friend for coding, creativity, learning, and everyday tasks.

Whether you're building an app, debugging code, exploring an idea, searching for information, or simply looking for a quick answer, Friindzy is designed to keep the conversation simple and useful.

BUILT FOR VIBE CODERS

Turn your ideas into working projects faster. Ask for code, understand errors, explore solutions, plan features, or discuss your next project with an AI assistant that fits naturally into your workflow.

CHAT YOUR WAY

Start a conversation whenever you need help and continue it later. Keep important conversations pinned and easily find your previous chats with built-in search.

POWERFUL AI, YOUR WAY

Friindzy supports custom Google AI Studio API keys, allowing you to bring your own keys and manage your AI access directly from the app. You can configure multiple keys for backup and flexibility.

MORE THAN JUST CHAT

Friindzy can help with much more than text conversations. Use available tools to create images, search the web, explore ideas, and get information for your projects.

SMART & CONTEXT-AWARE

Keep your conversations organized and continue from where you left off. Friindzy is designed to understand the context of your conversation so you can focus on what you're trying to accomplish.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH FRIINDZY

• Write and understand code
• Debug programming problems
• Generate ideas and project concepts
• Plan app and software features
• Learn programming concepts
• Ask questions and get explanations
• Search the web for information
• Create images with AI
• Continue previous conversations
• Pin important chats
• Quickly search your chat history
• Use your own Google AI Studio API keys
• Configure multiple API keys for flexibility

MADE FOR BUILDERS

From a small coding question to a complete app idea, Friindzy is built to be a helpful companion throughout your development journey.

Your ideas. Your projects. Your AI friend.

Start chatting with Friindzy.
